budget_estimate_s.basis: index build 65.5 s (2026-10-06, Apple arm64) and 6.3-6.7 s for K200 at n=65 here; rank 1.37-1.49e9 probes at 1.63e6 probes/s single-thread (n=65 K200 smoke on this container's Xeon) gives 14-15 min, the 2026-10-12 Linux VM measured 1,048 s for all single-worker IC preparation; IC online 5.6-13 s per target; strong rho about 2.5-5 s; packed rho 37-71 s

build.crypto_features: default-features = false (drops the redis TLS feature only; no cryptanalysis code is feature-gated by it)

ic.online_start: target_query_begin: first operation on Q (scan-origin hash), after base, normal basis, root index and the verified factor-log table are ready
ic.online_stop: recovery_check_end: [d]G = Q evaluated in the producer
ic.phase_sum_rule: five exclusive laps on one clock; their sum equals online_ms
ic.reusable_setup_once: rank stage + linear algebra, measured once in the precompute step on one pinned CPU; logged, excluded from online, charged in the cold ratio and the BL budget
ic.reusable_setup_per_process: setup_complete_ns: base load + normal basis self-test + root index + factor-log load and full [L_j]G=R_j verification; logged per arm, excluded from online

rho.online_start: after_target_built: the first walk start [c]G + Q
rho.online_stop: recovery_check_true: a distinguished-point collision returned d with [d]G = Q
rho.producer: koblitz_rho_batch_ks_strong_online wide path, KIC_RHO_RUNG=3, KIC_RHO_LANES=32, KIC_RHO_DP_BITS=4
rho.reusable_setup_per_process: online_start_ns: curve construction, normal basis, the 32 G-only r-adding jumps and parsing Q; logged per arm, excluded from online
rho.setup_dependence_resolution: strong rung 3's jumps are known multiples of G and every walk starts at [c]G+Q, so nothing before online_start depends on Q except parsing it; the old packed backend's 7.5 ms jump setup builds aG+bQ and is target dependent, and is inside that backend's total_ms. Both facts are by source inspection of the pinned files and are checked in every row: rho online_start_ns precedes its first walk, and Panel C reports packed setup_ms separately.

rho_legacy.online: total_ms = setup_ms (target-dependent aG+bQ jumps) + walk_ms + validation_ms; target_generation 0 for a public point
rho_legacy.producer: koblitz_rho_fixture packed backend, n>63 wide path

clocks.symmetry: Each arm's target-independent setup is measured in its own process on the same pinned CPU and excluded from online; the IC's once-per-job rank stage is measured on the same CPU class and reported, never hidden. Cold ratio = (IC per-process setup + rank stage + IC online) / (rho per-process setup + rho online).

decision_rule.abandon: if Panel A reads rho_online_faster, the n=83 vs_rho row records that the retained K600 IC is slower online than strong rho on this instance; no K or seed is re-chosen after seeing it
decision_rule.eligible_panel: all pairs valid under isolated_bench, every row's vs_rho claim passes validate_claim, both certificates replay in oracle.py, both arms recover the same scalar, and for Q0 that scalar equals the validation sidecar
decision_rule.headline_rule: Panel A's reading is the Tier 1 instance-scoped online result for Q0; it is always quoted with Panel B's section 23 figure, the cold ratio and the BL column, and never as a speed of the method (AGENTS.md section 2: the method is faster than rho only if its cold S is below rho's)

reading.no_result: not eligible; rows and failures are reported, no ratio is quoted

extends.crypto_ledger: docs/ic/BOUNDARY_TARGETS.md vs_rho row (n=61 a=0 isolated rung, 2026-10-12) and research/notes/index-calculus/RESEARCH_IC_BOUNDARY_LEDGER.md section 23
deviations_from_beat: K fixed at 600 with the retained base base_n83_K600.jsonl (base_hash d4a4da26...), not tuned over {200,600} with construct:83:1:K: the retained base binds this panel to the 2026-10-06 and 2026-10-12 evidence and avoids a tune pass the 6 h job cannot hold

the rank stage runs once per job (sequential, one pinned CPU, timed) and its factor-log table is reused by every IC arm through ic_log_cache.patch, verified [L_j]G=R_j for all 600 columns in every process; the beat rebuilds it in every process
processes run under the cryptanalysis Tier 1 runner scripts/isolated_bench.py (one exposed CPU, observed cgroup/steal/throttle counters) instead of taskset-only pinning
Panel A adds the frozen 2026-10-06 point Q0 with eight interleaved pairs; Panel B is the beat's first 16 eval points with one pair each
extends.replaces_as_primary: experiments/koblitz-single-target-n83-20261006 (three unisolated packed-rho pairs, median 8.2x); that rho backend is excluded as a vs_rho reference by RESEARCH_FIXED_REFERENCE_RHO_20261001.md and is kept here only as legacy Panel C

question: One previously unseen public point on EC1N83Ce1h35c7ced6b497 (a=1, n=83, r=8569786107849059, about 2^52.93): online wall time of the retained K600 compact-orbit IC against strong signed-Frobenius rho rung 3 on the same point, in one pinned-CPU envelope on a fresh instance, reported beside the cold ratio and the Bernstein-Lange model.

secondary: paired geometric mean with 20,000-draw bootstrap (seed 2026101283), the 2026-10-12 estimator
median IC and rho online ms, phase medians

B.primary: section 23: mean rho online over mean IC online across targets, 95% bootstrap over targets (10,000 resamples in pairs, seed 2026101400)
secondary: isolated_bench bootstrap95_by_target (median of per-target ratios, seed 20261003)

all: S = native ops / sqrt(r): IC root-index probes and rho walk steps, each in its own unit; no common unit is claimed
rho steps over the floor sqrt(pi r / (4n))
cold ratio IC over rho with interval
break-even targets = IC setup / (rho online - IC online) when positive
BL model column: IC online / (1.93*1.21*r*c^2/(2n*P)) with c = median rho ms per walk step on this instance and P = IC setup ms (per-process setup + rank stage); a model, no BL walk runs
